laws.name: District of Columbia Family and Medical Leave Act (DCFMLA)
laws.description: Provides job-protected unpaid leave for family and medical reasons for eligible employees in the District of Columbia.

laws.name: District of Columbia Paid Family Leave (DCPFML)
laws.description: Provides paid leave benefits funded through employer payroll taxes for bonding, family caregiving, medical leave, and prenatal leave.

laws.name: District of Columbia Parental Leave Act
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for school-related activities for parents and guardians.
